question: What is the average review score for each product category (English name) with at least 1000 delivered orders, lowest first? Show the 5 lowest.
model_sql:
WITH category_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_category_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT do.order_id) AS delivered_orders,
        AVG(do.review_score) AS avg_review_score
    FROM delivered_orders do
    JOIN order_items oi      ON oi.order_id = do.order_id
    JOIN products p          ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_category_name
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT do.order_id) >= 1000
)
SELECT 
    ce.product_category_name_english AS category,
    ROUND(avg_review_score, 2)        AS avg_review_score,
    delivered_orders
FROM category_orders co
JOIN category_en ce 
    ON ce.product_category_name = co.product_category_name
ORDER BY avg_review_score ASC
LIMIT 5
gold_sql: SELECT ce.product_category_name_english, ROUND(AVG(d.review_score),2) AS s FROM delivered_orders d JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT order_id, product_id FROM order_items) oi ON oi.order_id=d.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id JOIN category_en ce ON ce.product_category_name=p.product_category_name GROUP BY ce.product_category_name_english HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.order_id)>=1000 ORDER BY s ASC LIMIT 5
